verdict.rationale: Logseq's local HTTP API server serves its own API documentation at http://127.0.0.1:12315/ and the docs include copy-paste curl examples against the POST /api endpoint. The method reference itself is the community-driven plugin API docs, and there is no evidence that any of this documentation is interactive. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and the docs state that no sandbox is published. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser explorer, runnable/try-it examples beyond static curl snippets, an OpenAPI spec, an official (not community-driven) reference, and independent corroboration.
